title: Image-guided Adaptive Radiotherapy for Cervix Cancer: Patient Image Acquisition
brief_summary: Within this study patient data are collected from different imaging and motion monitoring devices that will be used to develop and test strategies for image-guided adaptive radiotherapy in cervix cancer patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histological diagnosis of cervix cancer
* Prescription of radiation treatment to the primary cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior radiation treatment to the pelvis
